candidates.change_summary: Return msg.sender instead of _owner, so owner() returns the caller rather than the stored owner.
Return address(0) instead of _owner, so owner() always returns the zero address.
Return _msgSender() instead of _owner, so owner() returns the caller via the context hook rather than the stored owner.
Remove the zero-address check so ownership can be transferred to address(0).
Invert the zero-address check so only transfers to address(0) succeed and any nonzero newOwner reverts.
Replace the ownership transfer target with address(0), effectively renouncing ownership instead of assigning newOwner.
Remove the internal ownership transfer call so owner() keeps its previous value after transferOwnership completes.
Remove the _checkOwner() call so any caller can transferOwnership, changing the resulting owner value for calls that previously reverted.
Invert the ownership check so only non-owners may call transferOwnership, changing which call sequences complete and the resulting owner value.
